storyInfo: The Generalik turns against his mother and stabs her. Scioppa jumps off his ship before it slams into a Fourth Army frigate. Eloysius and Vetochki crash the 'citizen's forum', and Vetochki speaks as a surviving miner. Having learned the honest thoughts of the nobles, Fyodor resolves to dissolve the legislature.

attributes.content: Govno... govno, govno, govno!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Where did those casters come from?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Why can't the guns kill them or even aim at them? Blyat, what are they—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Hierda
Anatoliy
attributes.content: Oh, Hierda—

attributes.name: Anatoliy
attributes.content: Hierda!
There you are. No, why are you here? Didn't I instruct for you to evacuate first?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: It's not safe here. I'll come and find you once I retake Zelgrad. Now, go to the base where my mother is—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I'm not going, Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...Even you defy me now?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: No, it's not that. I respect your authority and your decision. But did you forget what we talked about?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: You want me to return to your mother's side, even send me away first...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Who will protect you if I'm gone?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: My battleship, my glorious soldiers of Ursus—they still hold their ground! Many of them are cowards, but they make good enough cannon fodder.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I'll make Zelgrad great again and prove myself to Mother once I clear those fleeing pests out of Zelgrad—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Prove that I'm worthy of her name.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Anatoliy...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I can't always watch over you on the battlefield. Even though you're not by my side, your protection is always with me, isn't it?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: The young man smiles childishly as he points to the golden rocks on his body. Somehow, they have been growing in number.
You told your guards to escort me back to base, but your mother is already leaving it to go to the border.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...What?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Marshal Svetlana Ulyanova is abandoning you and Zelgrad. She doesn't even want to stay at the base near Zelgrad anymore.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: There's still time to come with me, Anatoliy—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Time to catch up to your mother's fleet... to get an answer.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: The Generalik has reached the base safely. We are ready to depart.
attributes.name: Runner

attributes.content: Good. We depart as soon as all units are ready.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Yes, Your High Excellency.
attributes.name: Runner

attributes.content: Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I can tell by your footsteps.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: You can tell it was me, yet you do not even turn. Do you not want to see my face anymore?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I must say that I am disappointed by your actions in Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Why did you not obey my order to retreat?
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: That's what I want to ask you... Mother.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Why did you abandon Zelgrad? Why did you leave it to the rebels, when you had promised me the city?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: We have gained everything we need from Project Zero. The city itself is worthless.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Our priority is to evacuate with the fruits of the research.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Unbelievable... they were telling the truth...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You have betrayed Ursus.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I'm protecting the First Army, and you.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Grypherburg is the epicenter of strife and intrigue right now. With the fruits of Project Zero in our hands, we'd be putting a target on our backs if we took a side.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I had hoped that you would understand this.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Aren't we glorious soldiers of Ursus? Aren't we fighting for the glory of Ursus?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I swore that I would bring down every last one of the empire's foes!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Enough. You're not in a good place. I'll have someone take over your mission. Go to your room and get some rest.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: There will come a day when I leave everything to you, Anatoliy... I only hope that when that day comes, you will not be as juvenile as you are today.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I don't understand... I don't even know who I am, Mother.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I'm not a glorious soldier of Ursus, I'm not an Infected, I'm not a pure-blood noble, I'm not even sure if I'm alive...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Enough! No more such talk—
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Why... why do you despise me so...?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Is it because I'm the son of a failure?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...No, Anatoliy, whatever the reasons I might be angry with you, your blood is not one of them.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: This is the one thing that you never had any choice in.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: But you don't deny that I share his blood.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Does it matter?
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Does it not?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I'm sure I must have gone mad, Mother.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Ugh—
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: It doesn't matter? How could it not matter? How else can I explain to myself—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Explain your indulgence and exploitation, your pampering and disinterest?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You never saw me as a son! I've only ever been an object, an object that needed no education, a tool for drawing attention!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: *cough* *cough*!
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: No... that's not true—
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Then what am I, Mother?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Something that can be cast aside at any moment... right?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Tolya, my child—
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: You're driving me mad.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Ah... so your blood runs hot too...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Ugh... argh—
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Tolya, no...
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Why...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Why couldn't I just be your son, a son you could be proud of?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I don't understand... why do things have to be so complicated?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: <p=1>Assault Ship Volnov, Command Center</><p=2> Jan 23, 1102, 00:32</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Our previous campaigns were like picnics compared to the pace we're making right now.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: This is what a high-speed battleship is like... max speed is usually not achievable in combat scenarios, but now—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Let's see what you can do.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: <p=2>120km from frigate, 30km/h</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Unknown assault ship...
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: This is Fourth Army Command. Identify yourself.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: ...It might be the Volnov...
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Repeat, identify yourself.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Thirty.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Stay on course.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: <p=2>100km from frigate, 42km/h</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Unknown ship, you are approaching a frigate of the Fourth Army. Identify yourself.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: This is your first warning. Identify yourself immediately to prove that you are not hostile and that you have not been hijacked.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: The target is not slowing down.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Have deck artillery on standby.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Roger.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Forty-two.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Continue.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: <p=2>75km from frigate, 55km/h</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Unknown ship, this is your second warning. Identify yourself immediately.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: The assault ship is on a direct course for the frigate, the only thing standing between it and the flagship.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Deck artillery standing by.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Fifty-five.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Steady.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: <p=2>50km from frigate, 68km/h</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Unknown ship, you have entered a restricted area. Identify yourself immediately!
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Under fifty klicks.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Artillery positions, begin tracking target.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Maintain radio silence.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: <p=2>30km from frigate, 78km/h</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Unknown ship, this is your final warning! Identify yourself immediately!
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Thirty klicks.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Get a firing solution.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Seventy-eight.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Steady as she goes.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: <p=2>20km from frigate, 85km/h</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Twenty klicks!
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Unknown ship, you are now within firing range!
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Open fire. Disable the ship, but do not destroy it.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: <p=2>10km from frigate, 91km/h</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Keep firing.
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Ninety-one.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Stay on course.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: ...Blyat, it's the Volnov... why is it still accelerating?
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Keep firing!
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: <p=2>5km from frigate, 6km from flagship, 93km/h</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: ...Bzzt...
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: ...Confirm hit—
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Confirm speed...
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Crazy zhopa!
attributes.name: Comms Voice

attributes.content: Stop your reckless action now, Scioppa Razin, and I will forgive Sechin's previous transgressions.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Take your men and return to your station.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Pfft...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I gotta give you credit. You're trying to negotiate, even when the other side's practically shitting on your face.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Don't worry, I'm just here to return the Volnov.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Besides, Sechin's no longer part of the Fourth Army, as of yesterday.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Any more stupid questions?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Mudak! You absolute fool—
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: First zhopa, now mudak. Well, I guess I'll let it slide for old time's sake.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: By the way, the navigation system of the Volnov is on lockdown and not even I can turn it off. I suggest you send your men to stop it quickly, otherwise...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Who knows what might happen?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Proshchay. Razin out.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: The second-floor deck is closest to open ground.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I'll count myself lucky if I don't fall to my death. I wish I had listened when Oleg was telling me about those safe-fall positions.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Oh, screw it—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: 'Stand up, they say.'
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.text: He's going down to the end of the road, all in our name♪
Up until the second day when the sun shall rise again♪
Still we advance, draw our blades, cut down our foes♪
Still we bleed, fall to the floor, bury our dead with woe♪
Still, history pushes us, back onto our own blades we go♪
For those who passed through the darkness and saw the face of death♪
One more day the land shall live♪
One more day we will be free♪

attributes.content: Hah... singing by myself is boring!
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: In Baba's name, what I should really sing is—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Durak politics, durak death —
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Tupoi, Viy!
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Hierda... there you are. I've been looking all over the place for you.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Why didn't you wait for me—*cough* *cough*!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...I'm leaving, Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I said, I'm leaving. I'm going to find my companions, whom I had entrusted to some people who could be trusted.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I should have been devoting myself to helping people who suffer...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: What about me? What about me?!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Come with me, Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: You will not find salvation here.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hah... yeah, of course! I stabbed my own mother because of you and that woman—because of what you said!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: No, it's not that. That was the right thing to do.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Your mother brought you pain, and brought war to the city, causing countless people to lose their homes. But your actions will bring life to even more.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...What?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You have atoned for your sins, Anatoliy. You have done well.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: You—*cough*—ugh!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Anatoliy...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hierda leans forward to examine the young man once more.
The yellow rocks have spread across his body, creating irregular lumps under his clothes.
It is the end for him.
What you think... doesn't matter anymore. Just...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Help me, one last time.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You can do it. Only you...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: But I don't want to, not anymore.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...Hierda?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: If this is to be your end, I will accept it. I don't want you to continue to devote yourself to a painful, meaningless life.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: This time, I won't help you anymore.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: It's almost ten. Everyone who walked in since nine-thirty was a noble.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Most of their faces are unfamiliar to me... but they aren't even trying to hide it, the way they behave themselves.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Has the time changed?
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: No. I think they just decided they wouldn't bother to hide it anymore.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: We've reached the point where a show of force feels better than to continue to deceive the Tsar, as one might play pretend with a child.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Is the Duchess Volkina not here yet?
attributes.name: Concerned Noble

attributes.content: The Central Army has not received any orders. The Capital Guard's assignments at the venue are within reasonable boundaries.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Perhaps she has chosen to stay on the sidelines, again.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: As expected... five minutes until it starts. Let us go in, Vice Chairman.
attributes.name: Concerned Noble

attributes.content: You go first... I'm waiting for someone.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: <p=1>Great Hall, The State Council of the Ursine Empire</><p=2> Jan 23, 1102</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Every seat in the hall is filled beneath the great dome of the State Council.
The ushers have led the attendees to their respective seats in an orderly manner, except—
The seats that should have been occupied by citizen's representatives from their respective raions are now occupied by taciturn nobles.
They wear neatly-ironed military uniforms or the latest fashion, wearing medals and luxurious fur shawls.
Clothes of every color surround skin and flesh, while the eyes follow the Tsar's steady steps.
No one stands, no one salutes. There's only a slow and stiff applause that seems intended to delay his speech.
(Whispers) Sir, I have sent hands to check on the representatives—
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Ensure their safety.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: (Whispers) I will. This is not unexpected. All you need to do is commit to pushing the Act through.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: (Whispers) The vote is simply a formality.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Fyodor nods wordlessly and passes Witte by, proceeding towards the podium on his own.
Suddenly, a young noble sitting in the front row stands up and salutes the Tsar with a smile.
All eyes are now upon this interlude.
There is no need for formalities. This is a special day.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Sit down and watch.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty, we came because we heard about the 'citizen's forum' being held today.
attributes.name: Young Noble

attributes.content: I did not prohibit spectators.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Of course, though it seems Your Imperial Majesty has made a small mistake.
attributes.name: Young Noble

attributes.content: We are not here as spectators. We are here as representatives of the 'citizens'.
attributes.name: Young Noble

attributes.content: After all—
attributes.name: Young Noble

attributes.content: She gestures at the room full of nobles.
Are we not the most important citizens of Ursus?
attributes.name: Young Noble

attributes.content: Before you continue your grandstanding, return to your seat.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: You are in my way.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Majesty—
attributes.name: Young Noble

attributes.content: And if you claim to represent the 'citizens'...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Then hear what the citizens of the Empire of Ursus truly need now.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Are you ready, Vetochki?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I-I'm ready!
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Don't worry about not being heard. You may stutter a little bit, but you know exactly what you're saying.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You've already said it once in the Far North under fire. These people have no weapons, only their tongues.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: All you need to do is reveal the truth...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: To say what you truly want to say.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Has the one you were waiting for arrived?
attributes.name: Concerned Noble

attributes.content: No, she hasn't...
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Then perhaps she won't. As you said yourself, she may have chosen to stay on the sidelines again—
attributes.name: Concerned Noble

attributes.content: Ah, it's about to begin.
attributes.name: Concerned Noble

attributes.content: The Tsar unrolls a piece of paper.

In recent days, he has spent long hours consulting Witte and his other trusted advisors, scrutinized the details with the Supreme Court, and discussed with the citizens' representatives to arrive at the final draft that he is now holding.
Even he is surprised at how calm his voice is.
On my way here, I saw fire pots set up along the roads to provide illumination at night.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Yet we all know that Deity Grypherburg had long stopped using oil lamps and bonfires to illuminate our streets, well before this became a nomadic city.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Perhaps the Grypherburg's nights are as they were a century ago, a situation that has carried on for two months.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: When the Originium mines closed, a once-affluent household in Grypherburg began burning furniture to stay warm.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: This was when I resolved to exploit the national Originium reserve, so we would not lose people to this harsh winter.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...Even that seems too little, too late.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Too late to prevent the Katorga Incident, and the reallocation of energy from Tsarevgrad to the residential districts can do little to stem the tide.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: This is a crisis on an unprecedented scale. It is not a temporary one, but one that threatens to wipe Ursus from the face of Terra, if no long-term solution is found.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The Winter Emergency Resource Allocation Act must be implemented.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Neither objection nor agreement, only silence.
...It is a provisional measure that will continue to be adjusted in practice, but it will at least save the people from the imminent plight of winter—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Does Your Imperial Majesty intend to nationalize the enterprises that we have worked so hard to build?
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: Or distribute the energy to the Armies in exchange for their obedience?
attributes.name: Reserved Noble

attributes.content: No amount of industry and enterprise, no amount of territory will mean anything, if Ursus does not survive the winter.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: In that case, why not simply read out the provisions and go straight to the vote?
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: Or have you decided that it is not worth the time to even go through the formalities, seeing our familiar faces?
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: (Whispers) Sir, message from Chairman Witte.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: (Whispers) About the original representatives... we just found out—
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: Fyodor's eyes widen as he sees the names on the piece of paper handed to him.
He frowns as he looks to the crowd.
All the whispering attendees have the same expression on them—one of scorn and mockery.
(Whispers) I'm sorry, sir... we made a mistake. We should have discovered the swap sooner.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: (Whispers) Chairman Witte says that there's still a way to reschedule and hold a true citizen's forum, if you wish.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...Understood.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: Speaking of familiar faces.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I'm sure you know that I have personally met with the elected citizen's representatives from the various raions, in order to make sure that the people's voices are heard.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Miners, grocers, pipeline workers, tutors, and other trades that I had never even heard of. New faces, all of them.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: It expanded my horizons and led me to reflect. I thought it was a beneficial thing, to learn about how the people live, to hear more about their real needs—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Only moments ago did I discover the truth.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: (Whispers) Did we overdo it...?
attributes.name: Concerned Noble

attributes.content: It was necessary.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: The people I met with were not who they claimed to be. They were not miners, grocers, pipeline workers, or tutors.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: They were actors from rural theaters, secretaries of counts, minor nobles whose names occupy a place at the very end of the Almanac of Nobility, the idle sons of wealthy urbanites—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: It all makes sense now.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Their unusual eloquence, compromises reached so easily, and ill-fitting clothes riddled with holes in locations unrelated to labor...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Yet I did not realize at the time.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Perhaps it takes a fool to be fooled.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: —No—
attributes.name: Voice from the Door

attributes.content: It is not so!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Who are you?!
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: How dare you intrude upon the council in session!
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: Wait, is she—
attributes.name: Concerned Noble

attributes.content: Upon seeing the face of the interloper, the nobles turn their heads to the Vice Chairman in the front row.
Vasily does not turn or respond to the countless eyes peering at him from behind.
His gaze is fixed on the Tsar on the podium, seemingly waiting for him to speak.
You...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Fyodor waves away the guards trying to stop the young woman.
What do you have to say?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: It is not so, Your Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You are not a fool. If you have been deceived, it is only because there are arrogant traitors in our midst, trampling upon your dignity with their dishonor.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: They are well-prepared, while you and those around you cannot be constantly watching them and their insidious plots.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Gorchikov! Tell your daughter to watch her tongue!
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: She's a grown woman. She's responsible for her own actions.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: You are... Eloysius Vasilyevna Gorchekova.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I am, Your Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I do not recognize the one with you. Who is she?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The true representative of the citizens.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: How do you prove that she is not an actor, like the ones on this list?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: She is a survivor of the Far North, one of the witnesses who should have testified against the Grand Duchess.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Anyone who heard that broadcast from the Far North will remember her voice.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: She and her fellow surviving miners should have been the representatives of Odoyev Raion.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The miners I saw—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I'm not sure you really saw any miners.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Why do you bring her here today?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: What you should be asking is, what does she want?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What do you want, Vetochki?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: H-Hello. I-I'm Vetochki. My mother calls me, Anya.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: I-I come from the, Far North, Mining District.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: I-I want everyone, at the treatment center, to have a, warm bed.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: I want, the Infected, to have a roof, over their heads.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: I-I want more, people like us—
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: To live through, the winter.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: I want to, vote for... uh...
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: ...The Winter Emergency Resource Allocation Act?
attributes.name: Fyodor
Vetochki
attributes.content: Y-Yes!

attributes.name: Vetochki
attributes.content: I want, to vote, so that people, won't die from, cold and illness.
C-Can I?
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Of course.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: 'Of course,' Your Imperial Majesty? What guarantee can you make to this poor girl?
attributes.name: Reserved Noble

attributes.content: You see? Those 'citizens' you speak of do not know how to rule a nation. You may be demonstrating your benevolence and mercy by allowing them to participate, but you are not truly helping them.
attributes.name: Reserved Noble

attributes.content: Even this Act that you speak of is ultimately taking from one mouth to feed another. It cannot solve any of the major issues Ursus is facing.
attributes.name: Reserved Noble

attributes.content: Besides, is this a playground or a middle school? Are people allowed to just walk in, claim to be somebody, and start lecturing on the nation's future?
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: There is nothing we can do, if you wish to ram this Act through. However, you must know—
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: I know.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...Huh?
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: I know all about the consequences.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I thought that the enemy of the empire stood at the border of the Central Governorate.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: It seems I was wrong.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The Tsar slams the pile of papers in his hand on the podium.
He scans the room, at the myriad expressions in the crowd.
The enemy of the empire is here.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Majesty! I must remind you that your reckless decision may cause you to pay—
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: Take him away.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Majesty!
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: Gorchikov! You coward! You and that spawn of yours will pay—
attributes.name: Unhappy Noble

attributes.content: Soldiers quickly 'escort' the noble out of the hall, his shouts echoing in the corridor.
Anyone who wishes to go with him should do so now.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: If there are none, I shall proceed to the resolution.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Majesty—
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Since those present are in agreement that the 'citizens' who comprise more than ninety percent of the empire's population do not deserve to have a voice...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: There is no need for a council that claims to represent these citizens.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty can't mean—
attributes.name: Reserved Noble

attributes.content: Gosudar...
attributes.name: Concerned Noble

attributes.content: The Winter Emergency Resource Allocation Act is hereby passed into law, effective immediately.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: In addition, as the Emperor and Autocrat of All the Ursines, I proclaim...
attributes.name: Fyodor
Fyodor
attributes.content: The entire legislature, both State Council and Imperial Duma...

attributes.name: Fyodor
attributes.content: are hereby dissolved.
